verses.text: Ay nanhal slajunhil heb' yinhtilalkan Israel mantzak scha sluum. Ix scha slum heb' chi' t'a lum Canaán, ix pojchajek' lu'um yuj winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun yinhtilal heb' israel. Ix pojjiek' lum t'a heb' t'a suerteal, hato syal b'aj ix sch'ox Dios t'a junjun makan heb' icha wal ajnak yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.

Yak'nakxopaxkan lum sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán winhaj Moisés t'a nanhal yoxilxo makan heb' yinhtilalkan Israel chi'. Haxo pax heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví, malaj slum heb' ix ak'ji, yujto a heb' yinhtilalkan José, chab' makan ix aj heb', haton heb' yik Manasés yet' heb' yik Efraín. Yuj chi' a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví chi' maj yik' junok makan sluum heb' b'aj junnhej tz'ajkani, palta anhej juntzanh chonhab' b'aj syal skajnaj heb' yet' lum ay t'a spatiktak schonhab' heb' chi' b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb', haton chi' ix ak'ji t'a heb'.
Ix spojek' lum heb' israel chi' t'a spatik icha wal ajnak yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Judá ix jawi heb' t'a Gilgal yik slolon heb' yet' winhaj Josué. Haxo winhaj Caleb kenezeo yuninal winhaj Jefone, ix halan t'a winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: Nakot tas yalnak Jehová t'a winh schekab', haton winhaj Moisés, ayik yalannak uuj yet' wuuj ayik ayonh ek' t'a Cades-barnea.
Yiktax 40 ab'il in k 'inal, schekannak onh kot winh t'a Cades-barnea chi', yuj kulnakek' kil tastak yilji jun lu'um tik. Haxo yik ko k'ochnakxi, icha wal aj wilan lu'um, icha chi' wutej walani.

Haxo pax juntzanhxo heb' winh ulek' ket'ok, manh wach'ok yutej heb' winh yalani, xib'tej heb' anima chi' heb' winh, a onhxo pax tik jun, wach' kutej kalani, yujto tojolnhej yaj ko pensar t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal.

Yuj chi' ha t'a jun k'u chi', yak'kan sti' winhaj Moisés t'ayin, yalan winh icha tik: Ha lum lum b'aj ix ach ek' il chi', ik yaj lum yet' heb' inhtilal t'a junelnhej, yujto te tojol a pensar t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, xchikan winh.

Ha jun tik 45 ab'ilxo yalankan winhaj Moisés chi' yuj Jehová, ayik ayonhek' t'a tzinan lu'um. Ha yuj tas yalnakkan winh chi', yuj chi' pitzan hinto ek' yuj Jehová. Ha tiknaik jun, ayxo 85 ab'il in k 'inal,
palta tek'an hinto swab'i, icha yik schekannak onh kot winhaj Moisés chi' kil lu'um, hanheja' icha chi' in tek'anil swab'i, tzato yal wib'xi yet' wak'an owal, icha t'a yik chi'.

Yuj chi' swal t'ayach to tzak' lum tzalkixtak t'ayin, icha ajnak yalan Jehová t'ayin. Hab'nak to hata' kajan heb' niwak winak yinhtilal winhaj Anac, te niwak yaj schonhab' heb' sb'oani, te wach' yajoch smuroal, palta a in tik, swak'och Jehová yipok in k'ool to ha' ol kolwaj wet'ok, yik ol yal wik'anel heb' ta', icha ix yutej yalani, xchi winhaj Caleb chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yal wach' lolonel winhaj Josué t'a yib'anh winhaj Caleb chi', ix yak'an lum Hebrón winh t'a winh yet' t'a masanil yinhtilal.
Icha chi' ix aj yochkan lum Hebrón chi' yikok winhaj Caleb yet' heb' yinhtilal t'a junelnhej, yujto tojol spensar winh t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Ha chonhab' Hebrón chi', Arba sb'i t'a peka', yujto Arba sb'i jun winh te chaanh steel ay smay t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Anac. Ixlajwi yik'ankan slum junjun makan yinhtilal heb' israel chi', ix och waan owal t'a jun lugar chi'.
